value.syntax: # [doc = " A match in progress: the resolved theory, the compiled patterns, and the"] # [doc = " two pieces of state a match carries."] pub (crate) struct Evaluator < 'a > { table : & 'a RuleTable , patterns : & 'a BTreeMap < usize , XsdPattern > , # [doc = " The first budget exhaustion since it was last taken, if any."] exhausted : Option < Exhaustion > , # [doc = " The rule names entered since the last descent into a value: the"] # [doc = " guard against a rule that references itself without consuming"] # [doc = " anything."] visiting : Vec < & 'a str > , # [doc = " Generic parameter bindings, innermost last."] scopes : Vec < Vec < (& 'a str , & 'a Type1) > > , # [doc = " How many values deep the match currently is: the guard against a"] # [doc = " rule that references itself *through* a value against a document"] # [doc = " nested deeply enough to overflow the call stack."] depth : usize , }
